title: Def 4.2 - Krunks Place
description: The leading optimization and QoL modpack for Krunk’s Place SMP
body:
![Def 4.2 Windows Edition](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbb1acace1d53a51c2d644e0e79b257da9058a4f.png)
# Def 4.1 Krunks Place Leading Optimisation & Qol Modpack
Equipped with better vanilla textures, small UI tweaks, optimization tweaks, better window options, and more!

This modpack is designed to deliver the best optimisation experience for the Krunk’s Place SMP server. While it was created specifically for use on the Krunk’s Place SMP, it can also be used on other servers.

This is the **Windows Edition** of the modpack, a edition for MacOS on Intel or Silicon systems will be coming soon.

If you find any issues, feel free to ask for support by reaching out to me on [Discord](https://discord.gg/82EcggR3ct) and i'll try to help out! Also join if you have any feedback you want to share - all is welcome.)

![Simply Optimized Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/01410fc6ec200ffef9b65f45766688d1047ad0bb.png)

How does it run so well? I have [Simply Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop) to thank for that, Simply Optimized in my opionion is the BEST Optimized modpack for minecraft, which is why I decided to use it as a base for this modpack, please go show [HyperSoop](https://modrinth.com/user/HyperSoop) some support, what he/she has done as far as optimization goes is increadable.

![Included mods Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d70e92d5eeabfe66dd5870d6ed1a749cd86f177e.png)

## QoL Mods:
- [3D Skin Layers](https://modrinth.com/mod/3dskinlayers) by [tr7zw](https://modrinth.com/user/tr7zw) Allows compatible skins to include 3D layers
- [Accurate Block Placement Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/accurate-block-placement-reborn) by [Schwar](https://modrinth.com/user/schwar) & [Kaddicus](https://modrinth.com/user/Kaddicus) Impoves apon vanilla block placement
- [Auth Me](https://modrinth.com/mod/auth-me) by [Axieum](https://modrinth.com/user/axieum) Allows users to Authenticate themselves and re-validate their sessions
- [AutoRelog](https://modrinth.com/mod/autorelog) by [Scubakay](https://modrinth.com/user/Scubakay) Automatically reconnect to a restarting server while AFK!
- [Better Statistics Screen](https://modrinth.com/mod/better-stats) by [TheCSDev](https://modrinth.com/user/TheCSDev) Improves the statistics screen
- [Continuity](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity/versions) by [PepperCode1](https://modrinth.com/user/PepperCode1) Allows for efficient connected textures
- [Controlling](https://modrinth.com/mod/controlling) by [jaredlll08](https://modrinth.com/user/jaredlll08) Adds a search bar to the Key-Bindings menu
- [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade) by [Snownee](https://modrinth.com/user/Snownee) Shows information about what you are looking at
- [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) by [Masa](https://modrinth.com/user/masa) A client-side schematic mod
- [Mica](https://modrinth.com/mod/mica) by [LemonCaramel](https://modrinth.com/user/LemonCaramel) A window management tool for minecraft
- [No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports) by [Aizistral](https://modrinth.com/user/Aizistral) & [Robotkoer](https://modrinth.com/user/robotkoer) Makes chat unreportable (where possible)
- [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) by [FlashyReese](https://modrinth.com/user/FlashyReese) Alternative Options Menu for Sodium
- [Searchables](https://modrinth.com/mod/searchables) by [Jaredlll08](https://modrinth.com/user/jaredlll08) Helper methods that allow for searching and filtering elements
- Pick Up Notifier
- [FancyMenu](https://modrinth.com/mods?q=fancy%20menu) by [Keksuccino](https://modrinth.com/user/keksuccino) Custom Minecraft menus!

## Optimisation Mods:
- [BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations) by [thosea](https://modrinth.com/user/thosea) Low-impact miscellaneous optimizations
- [Concurrent Chunk Management](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) by [ishland](https://modrinth.com/user/ishland) & [duplexsystem](https://modrinth.com/user/duplexsystem) Designed to improve the chunk performance
- [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) by [tr7zw](https://modrinth.com/user/tr7zw), [Pelotrio](https://modrinth.com/user/Pelotrio) & [vicisacat](https://modrinth.com/user/vicisacat) uses async path-tracing to hide Block-/Entities that are not visible
- [FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) by [malte0811](https://modrinth.com/user/malte0811) Memory usage optimizations
- [ImmediatelyFast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) by [RaphiMC](https://modrinth.com/user/RaphiMC) Speeds up immediate mode rendering
- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mods?q=Lithium) by [Jellysquid3](https://modrinth.com/user/jellysquid3) No-compromises game logic optimization mod
- [ModernFix](https://modrinth.com/mod/modernfix) All-in-one mod that improves performance
- [More Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/moreculling) by [FX](https://modrinth.com/user/FX) & [1Foxy2](https://modrinth.com/user/1Foxy2) Changes how multiple types of culling are handled in order to improve performance
- [Noisium](https://modrinth.com/mod/noisium) by [Steveplays](https://modrinth.com/user/Steveplays) Optimises worldgen performance for a better gameplay
- [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) by [Caffeinemc](https://modrinth.com/organization/caffeinemc) The fastest and most compatible rendering optimization mod
- [ThreadTweak](https://modrinth.com/mod/threadtweak) by [getchoo](https://modrinth.com/user/getchoo) & [devin](https://modrinth.com/user/devin) Improve and tweak Minecraft thread scheduling
- [Very Many Players](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric) by [ishland](https://modrinth.com/user/ishland) Designed to improve server performance at high playercounts

- Cloth Config API by [Shedaniel](https://modrinth.com/user/shedaniel) Configuration Library for Minecraft Mods
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) by [Modmuss50](https://modrinth.com/user/modmuss50) & [sfPlayer1](https://modrinth.com/user/sfPlayer1) Lightweight and modular API providing common hooks and intercompatibility measures utilized by mods using the Fabric toolchain
- [Forge Config API Port](https://modrinth.com/mod/forge-config-api-port) by [Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/user/Fuzs)
- [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) [Masa](https://modrinth.com/user/masa) & [sakura-ryoko](https://modrinth.com/user/sakura-ryoko)
- [Puzzles Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzles-lib) by [Fuzs](https://modrinth.com/user/Fuzs) light-weight library consisting of multiple frameworks and utility classes.
- [TCDCommons API](https://modrinth.com/mod/tcdcommons) by [TheCSDev](https://modrinth.com/user/TheCSDev) TheCSDev's personal library mod
